# dependabot-terraform

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Dependabot-Terraform provides support for bumping Terraform modules via Dependabot. If you want support for multiple package managers, you probably want the meta-gem dependabot-omnibus.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core
- 更新日志: https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/releases/tag/v0.397.0
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/dependabot-terraform
